prompt_format.declarations: text-scanned top-level def/class header lines with full-body range and range_sha256 (no AST)
prompt_format.delta: RAW native /usr/bin/diff -u hunks; old numbers predecessor, new numbers candidate
prompt_format.projection: per case '/cases/<i> L<line> <compact JSON of named keys>' with exact parsed values (canonical JSON formatting, not raw bytes)
prompt_format.raw: verbatim bytes between BEGIN/END markers with path, inclusive LF range, byte offsets [x,y), range_sha256, file_sha256, file_bytes, file_lines
prompt_format.requested_reply: line 1 'SLICE <ID> SOURCE-ONLY VERDICT: ...'; A prior-finding table; B findings; C conditional joins; D coverage; E remaining empirical obligations; F no-grant sentence
